features.heading: Features
features.no_features_body: Feature controls will appear here after config/features.yml declares at least one feature.

chat_polish.name: Chat polish
chat_polish.description: Subtle chat animations: new messages fade in, the new-messages jump scrolls smoothly. Motion-safe (respects reduced-motion).

video_walkthroughs.name: Walkthrough videos
video_walkthroughs.description: Record or drag a narrated screen recording into a chat; Gemini analyzes it and the chat agent works it toward an Epic. Requires a Gemini API key.

coding_mode.name: Coding Mode
coding_mode.description: Enables Coding Mode for Syrus Chat, allowing the agent to implement code changes directly in the session checkout instead of just planning.

performance_logging.name: Performance logging
performance_logging.description: Records structured slow request, SQL, and phase events to logs and a short-lived admin diagnostics buffer.

local_mode.name: Local Mode
local_mode.description: Enables the Local chat mode and the `syrus local` daemon command. The agent connects to a daemon running on the user's local machine via a reverse WebSocket tunnel to read/write files and run commands locally.

agent_insights.name: Agent Insights
agent_insights.description: Enables agent insight analysis jobs that inspect recent workflow runs and surface improvement suggestions.

unified_work_engine_reconciler.name: Unified work-engine reconciler
unified_work_engine_reconciler.description: Makes the unified work-engine reconciler authoritative for work-state recovery. When enabled, legacy reapers and auto-retry fixers defer instead of mutating state independently.

invitations.heading: Invitations
invitations.description: Generate one-time signup links. Default expiry is 7 days, and invitations work even when open signups are disabled.

settings.heading: App settings
settings.currently_set: Currently set. Blank update fields will not clear it.
settings.signups_open_help: When enabled, anyone can create an account at /users/new. When disabled, signup is invitation-only, but invitation links still work either way.
settings.video_retention_help: How long uploaded walkthrough videos are kept before removal. The analysis and its screenshots always stay in the chat.
settings.video_budget_help: Instance-wide cap on total stored walkthrough videos. When exceeded, the oldest videos are removed first. Set 0 for no cap.
settings.max_concurrent_agent_runs_help: Cluster-wide cap on how many agent Runs execute at once, across all worker pods. Set this when running multiple workers so total agent concurrency (and cost / rate-limit exposure) doesn't scale with pod count. 0 = unlimited (bounded only by each pod's JOB_CONCURRENCY). Landing and main-branch grader runs are not counted.
settings.proactive_rebase_commit_threshold_help: Number of commits a PR must be behind its base before Syrus proactively rebases it, even when GitHub's mergeable_state is clean. Useful when branch-protection does not require branches to be up to date. Must be at least 1.

github_app.register_description: Register the singleton Syrus GitHub App. Repositories use App credentials only after the App is installed on their GitHub account or repository.
github_app.confirm_description: Syrus stored the App credentials and queued an installation sync.
github_app.error_load_register: Unable to load GitHub App registration.
github_app.step_1: Install the App on your repositories via GitHub.
github_app.step_2: Wait for the installation sync, or let the 5-minute recurring sync pick it up.
github_app.step_3: Keep a personal access token configured for repositories that do not have an active App installation.
github_app.register_instructions: GitHub will create the App from the manifest, then redirect back here with temporary credentials. Registration alone does not grant repository access; install the App after registration.
github_app.no_stored_registration: No GitHub App registration is stored.

installations.heading: GitHub App Installations
installations.description: Syrus uses the GitHub App for repositories with an active installation. Repositories without one use the owner's personal access token fallback.
installations.app_not_registered_title: Syrus App is not registered yet.
installations.app_not_registered_body: Register the GitHub App before installing it on repositories. Until then, configured repositories run through PAT fallback.
installations.install_on_all: Install on all PAT-only repos in this account
installations.github_ids_missing: GitHub IDs missing; re-select these repos from the registration form.
installations.compare_pat_1: Used when no active App installation exists
installations.compare_app_1: Used when the App is registered and installed on the repo account
installations.compare_app_2: Actions appear as the App bot
installations.compare_pat_3: Can't approve your own PRs via normal flow
installations.compare_pat_4: Shares your personal API rate limit
installations.compare_pat_5: Required as fallback for PAT-only repos
installations.compare_app_5: Does not replace PAT fallback for repos without an installation

stuck.heading: Stuck Things
stuck.nothing_stuck: Nothing stuck. Reaper, pruner, and worker pool are all keeping up.

console.heading: Operator Console
console.reap_description: Runs the stale-run reaper inline when the recurring reaper itself may be starved.
console.github_cache_description: Drops per-user GitHub ETag cache entries when conditional GET responses are stale.
console.polling_description: Stops recurring fan-out jobs from enqueueing per-Job pollers while leaving manual poll buttons available.
console.runs_description: Defers new RunJob work at perform time. Already-running Runs continue.
console.merge_train_description: When on, an Epic's children land together as one atomic merge (graded once) instead of individually. While enabled, Epic children land only via the train, never via the per-Job path.

queue.heading: Queue
queue.queue_unreachable: SolidQueue tables are unreachable from this connection.
